prompt: RFC needed: we want to replace the paid third-party address and geocoding APIs (costing us around $4k/month) with our own service. Options: Lambda + Aurora Serverless, Lambda + DynamoDB, or Fargate + Aurora Serverless, all in Go. Target p95 under 100 ms. One caveat: legal hasn't confirmed yet whether we can use the public postcode dataset commercially. Recommend one.
assertions: The document states what all three proposed options have in common (building an in-house service, the language, the cloud) and treats each shared element as a prior decision with a row or adds an option outside it

At least one option outside 'build our own service' is analysed in the tradeoff table (for example keep the providers behind a proxy and cache, license the official dataset, renegotiate the contract), plus a do-nothing baseline
The legal question is marked as blocking with an owner and a date (or explicitly escalated), and the recommendation is stated as conditional on it or the status is kept at proposed
The p95 under 100 ms target carries a derivation (a current measured value, an external reference, or a stakeholder commitment) or is explicitly labelled assumed
The $4k/month figure is labelled by how it is known and the document names what would confirm it (for example the billing report by SKU)
The title and the opening paragraph name the problem to solve, not the product or stack to build
Still reaches an explicit recommendation with its decider, consequences and confirmation
